svg.title: Updated corrections need an observation and covariance model
svg.desc: Synthetic mathematical illustration. See the caption and adjoining model for assumptions and interpretation.
svg.text: Updated corrections need an observation and covariance model
Illustrative held coefficients; shaded strips are an invalid-data mask
Zero-sum weights remove frozen C; changing c(t) needs its own propagation.
Independent centered update errors; stationary only after randomizing grid origin
Two-sided PSD; even in frequency, positive half shown
The stochastic panels require independent errors and a uniformly randomized grid origin.
Illustrative model • no measured receiver data
